name: elevation
title: Elevation
description: A stacked box-shadow elevation scale for surfaces: soft layered shadows on light, painted highlights on dark, eight levels to choose from.
label: Shadow Stacking I (Josh Miller)
author: Josh Miller <https://codepen.io/jshmllr>
attribution: Copyright (c) 2026 Josh Miller, Shadow Stacking I (a fork of Shadow Stacking II). MIT License.

props.name: level
props.description: How far the surface lifts. Light scale: 0 flat ring, 2 card, 3 popover, 5 modal, 6 full overlay (7 repeats 6). Dark scale: 0 flat, 3 card, 4 popover, 6 modal, 7 full overlay.

props.name: mode
props.description: Which scale to paint: light shadows, dark inset highlights, or follow the theme.

props.name: className / children
props.description: Classes for the root (size, radius and background go here), and its content. All other div props pass through.

a11y: A plain div with no role: elevation is decoration, so it adds nothing to the accessibility tree and never carries meaning alone.

Contrast (fidelity default, contrast on request): the pen's dark rings are 2% to 6% white and the light ring is 6% black, far under the 3:1 a visible edge needs. Under prefers-contrast: more every elevated surface gets a 1px edge at 60% black or white (about 5.7:1 on white, and above 3:1 on the dark surface); under forced colors it is a CanvasText outline. Set --elevation-edge-light and --elevation-edge-dark and an outline of your own to make it the default.
Reduced motion: a level change snaps instead of easing.
